# eon_permissions (Data Source)

Retrieves the catalog of permissions available for composing custom role permission lists. Useful as input when creating `eon_role` resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List available permissions for custom roles
data "eon_permissions" "all" {}

# Example: Use a permission when creating a custom role
resource "eon_role" "inventory_viewer" {
  name = "inventory-viewer"

  permission_grants = [
    {
      permission = [
        for p in data.eon_permissions.all.permissions : p.permission_type
        if p.permission_type == "inventory.view"
      ][0]
    }
  ]
}

output "permission_types" {
  description = "Available permission type identifiers"
  value       = [for p in data.eon_permissions.all.permissions : p.permission_type]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) List of available permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `allow_conditions` (Boolean) Whether the permission can be restricted with access conditions when used in a custom role.
- `description` (String) Description of the actions the permission allows.
- `permission_type` (String) Permission identifier (for example `inventory.view`).
